verdict.rationale: Kong AI Gateway's AI MCP Proxy can front upstream MCP servers and govern MCP traffic, so the product does connect to external MCP servers. However, it acts as a proxy that relays their tools to other clients rather than consuming the tools itself, and the docs describe this only briefly. Missing for 10: evidence that the gateway itself invokes or uses plugged-in MCP tools, detailed setup docs for registering upstream MCP servers, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: AI MCP Proxy bridges Kong-managed Services to the Model Context Protocol, converting REST APIs into MCP tools or fronting upstream MCP servers.
AI Gateway enables teams to manage remote MCP traffic with enterprise-grade security, performance, authentication, context propagation, load balancing, and observability.
